name: conspiracy minded
quote: The pandemic was created in a lab to rid the world of old people.
description: A pattern of believing that important aspects of the world are controlled by hidden agents with selfish agendas.

variations.name: paranoid conspiracy
variations.description: A pattern of believing that hidden agents with selfish agendas are actively working against you personally.
examples: using a tinfoil hat to prevent aliens from reading your mind

comparisons.description: Cynicism is a general distain for the less pleasant aspects of human nature like ignorance and selfishness. Conspiracy theorists assume shadowy groups are actively controlling the world for their own benefit.

commentaries.quote: We tend to make up [stories] in the same circumstances in which people come up with conspiracy theories: ignorance and powerlessness. And they share the same flawed premise as most conspiracy theories: that the world is way more well planned and organised that it really is. They ascribe a malevolent intentionality to what is more likely simple ineptitude or neglect. Most people are just too self-absorbed, well-meaning, and lazy to bother orchestrating Machiavellian plans to slight or insult us. It's more often a boring, complicated story of wrong assumptions, miscommunication, bad administration, and cover-ups - people trying, and mostly failing, to do the right thing, hurting each other not because that's their intention but because it's impossible to avoid.

Sure, there have been actual conspiracies in history, like Watergate. But that doesn't mean the world is full of them. Why did it take so long for women to get the vote? (a) it was a 2500-year conspiracy or (b) it was deeply unfortunate cultural intertia? It may be worth considering ignorance and habit before assuming worse.

conditions: A pattern of believing that important aspects of the world are controlled by hidden agents with selfish agendas.
